I cross the guild hall to the clerk's counter and ask where I can buy trail provisions on the way out of town.
I head for the provisions seller the clerk described.
I ask how much a day's food for the road costs.
I thank them and leave the food for now. I head west for the Old Crown Catacombs.
I keep to the road to the old chapel, taking in what I can see along the way.
I look around for signs that someone has been here recently.
I walk to the entrance of the catacombs and listen for a moment.
I make my way inside to the first chamber.
I study the nearest wall in the light from the entrance.
I stand still for a moment and listen to the space around me.
